titleEn: Townhouse Bathroom Renovation in Metro Vancouver: 2026 Costs, Strata Rules & Real Projects
titleZh: 大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新（2026）：真实费用、物业规定和案例
contentEn:
In Metro Vancouver, a townhouse bathroom renovation typically costs $14,000 to $65,000 depending on scope and location. A recent Delta townhouse project — three full bathrooms plus a powder room — came in at $40,000–$43,000, completed in 6–8 weeks. This guide breaks down real townhouse bathroom costs across Delta, Surrey, Burnaby, Coquitlam, and North Vancouver in 2026, with specific strata rules for each municipality.

What Does a Townhouse Bathroom Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver?

Townhouse bathroom costs in Metro Vancouver run higher than single-family homes because most renovations require strata approval before work begins. That approval process adds 2–6 weeks to the timeline and limits which contractors and finishes you can use.

Three cost tiers define most townhouse bathroom projects in 2026:

  • Refresh ($14,000–$22,000): New vanity, toilet, flooring, paint, and bathroom fixtures. No plumbing relocation. Strata approval usually straightforward.
  • Standard Reno ($22,000–$43,000): Full tile work, new shower or tub, vanity upgrade, and lighting. Some plumbing adjustments. Most common range for townhouse projects.
  • Luxury Master Bath ($43,000–$65,000+): Freestanding tub, heated floors, custom tile, walk-in shower with glass, and high-end fixtures. Strata rules in newer complexes can limit exterior changes.

Budget overruns in townhouse projects most often come from hidden plumbing issues discovered after walls open, and from special strata requirements in older complexes built before 1990.

Real Townhouse Bathroom Renovation Project — Delta

Reno Stars recently completed a three-and-a-half bathroom renovation in a Delta townhouse. The project covered:

  • Main bathroom: walk-in shower with large porcelain tiles and freestanding bathtub
  • Children's bathroom: practical bathtub with slip-resistant flooring
  • Ground-floor powder room: warm-toned accent tiles with matte black fixtures
  • Basement bathroom: complete waterproofing, new shower, and fresh finishes throughout

Contract value: $40,000–$43,000. Timeline: 6–8 weeks. The project involved coordinating four distinct trades across all bathrooms simultaneously — a typical constraint for townhouse strata complexes where noise and working-hour restrictions apply.

For the full project details, visit Delta Townhouse Bathroom Renovation Case Study.

Strata Rules and Permits for Townhouse Bathroom Renovations in Metro Vancouver

Every municipality in Metro Vancouver has its own permit requirements, but the common constraint is the strata corporation. Before any contractor pulls a permit, most townhouse complexes require:

  • Strata council approval (formally filed, not just verbal)
  • Deposit or security bond (refundable upon completion)
  • Proof of contractor liability insurance naming the strata corporation
  • Scope of work description with drawings

In Delta, bathroom renovations that move plumbing require a building permit plus a plumbing permit. The strata council must approve the application before the city issues the permit. Delta's Tsawwassen area has additional drainage regulations for projects that add new drain connections.

In Surrey and North Vancouver, renovations that do not alter structural elements or plumbing locations — such as replacing a vanity, retiling, or changing fixtures — may qualify for an expedited permit. Moving a toilet or shower drain always requires a full permit regardless of municipality.

In Coquitlam and Port Coquitlam, townhouse complexes built before 1990 may fall under heritage consideration if the complex is on the heritage register. This can add 4–8 weeks to permit approval. Reno Stars handles heritage applications as part of standard project management — this service is included in the project fee.

How to Hire a Contractor for a Townhouse Bathroom Reno in Metro Vancouver

Three criteria separate good townhouse bathroom contractors from general renovators in Metro Vancouver:

  • Strata experience: The contractor must have filed strata applications before and know what each complex's bylaws require. Ask for references from two previous townhouse projects in the same municipality.
  • Licensed and insured: In BC, a licensed residential builder is required for any renovation over $5,000. Verify the licence at licensingbc.ca.
  • Project manager on-site: Townhouse renovations involve coordinating with the strata property manager, sometimes the city inspector, and multiple trades. A dedicated site manager prevents cost overruns from miscommunication.

Planning a townhouse bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars — we have completed townhouse projects in Delta, Surrey, Burnaby, Coquitlam, and North Vancouver.

How long does a townhouse bathroom renovation take in Metro Vancouver?

A single townhouse bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver takes 3–6 weeks from permit approval to handover. For projects involving 3 or more bathrooms in a single townhouse unit, budget 6–10 weeks. Strata approval adds 2–6 weeks before any permit is filed. Reno Stars manages the strata application as part of standard project delivery.

Does a townhouse bathroom renovation require strata approval in BC?

Yes, in nearly all cases. The Strata Property Act requires strata council approval for any alteration that affects common property, adjacent units, or the exterior of the building. Even renovations contained entirely within your unit — new tile, vanity, toilet — typically require a strata notification form. Your contractor should handle the strata submission as part of the project scope.

Can I renovate one bathroom at a time in my townhouse?

Yes. Staggered renovations are common in townhouses where the family needs to remain in the home. Reno Stars typically completes one bathroom at a time, working room by room. This extends the overall project timeline but keeps living disruption manageable. Coordinate with your strata to establish working hours and elevator or stairwell access for materials.

What is the average cost of a townhouse bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026?

The average townhouse bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026 ranges from $22,000 to $43,000 for a standard full renovation. A luxury master bathroom with custom tile, heated floors, and high-end fixtures runs $43,000 to $65,000+. A basic refresh — new vanity, flooring, paint, and fixtures — starts at $14,000. All figures are based on completed project contracts, not estimates.

大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新费用通常在$14,000至$65,000之间，具体取决于工程范围和所在城市。聚星裝修最近完成的一个Delta联排别墅项目——三间全套浴室加一间洗手间——合同金额为$40,000至$43,000，工期为6至8周。本指南按Delta、Surrey、Burnaby、Coquitlam和North Vancouver各城市，拆解2026年大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新的真实费用及物业规定。

大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新费用是多少？

大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新费用高于独立屋，因为大多数项目需要物业审批才能开工。该审批流程使工期延长2至6周，并限制了可使用的承包商和饰面材料。

2026年大多数联排别墅浴室项目分为三个费用等级：

  • 基本翻新（$14,000–$22,000）：新洗手柜、马桶、地板、墙面刷新和五金件。无管道移位。物业审批通常较简单。
  • 标准翻新（$22,000–$43,000）：全面瓷砖工程、新淋浴间或浴缸、洗手柜升级和照明。部分管道调整。最常见的工程范围。
  • 豪华主卧浴室（$43,000–$65,000+）：独立式浴缸、地暖、定制瓷砖、步入式淋浴间和高端五金件。较新物业小区可能限制外墙改造。

联排别墅项目中，超预算最常见的原因是墙板打开后发现的隐藏管道问题，以及老旧物业小区（1990年前建造）的特殊物业规定。

真实联排别墅浴室翻新案例 — Delta

聚星裝修最近完成了Delta一栋联排别墅的三间半浴室翻新。项目包括：

  • 主浴室：步入式淋浴间配大规格瓷砖和独立式浴缸
  • 儿童浴室：实用浴缸配防滑地板
  • 地面层洗手间：暖色调特色瓷砖配哑光黑五金件
  • 地下室浴室：全面防水处理、新淋浴间和全屋饰面更新

合同金额：$40,000–$43,000。工期：6至8周。项目涉及同时协调四个不同工种——这是联排别墅物业小区的典型约束，涉及噪音和工作时间限制。

完整项目详情，请访问：Delta联排别墅浴室翻新案例研究。

大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新的物业规定和许可证

大温哥华每个城市的许可证要求各不相同，但共同约束是物业 corporation。在承包商申请许可证之前，大多数联排别墅小区要求：

  • 物业委员会正式批准（需正式提交，不能仅口头同意）
  • 押金或保证金（完工后可退还）
  • 承包商责任保险证明，且保险受益人需注明物业 corporation
  • 含图纸的工程范围说明

在Delta，移动管道的浴室翻新需要建筑许可证和管道许可证。物业委员会必须先批准申请，城市才会颁发许可证。Delta的Tsawwassen地区对于新增排水连接的项目有额外的排水规定。

在Surrey和North Vancouver，不改变结构元素或管道位置的翻新（如更换洗手柜、重新铺瓷砖、更换五金件）可能有资格申请快速许可证。移动马桶或淋浴间排水管的工程则无论在哪个城市，都需要全面许可证。

在Coquitlam和Port Coquitlam，1990年前建造的联排别墅小区如果列入遗产名录，可能需要额外考虑。这会使许可证审批时间延长4至8周。聚星裝修将遗产申请作为标准项目管理的一部分处理——此服务包含在项目费用中。

常见联排别墅浴室布局及翻新可实现的改变

大温哥华大多数联排别墅浴室属于三种布局类型，每种有不同的翻新范围：

布局类型常见面积常见工程范围预估费用区间
地面层洗手间 + 楼上浴室两件套 + 四件套两间浴室全面翻新；尽可能移动管道$28,000–$43,000
3–4间全套浴室两层分期翻新以便居住；一次完成2–3间$40,000–$65,000+
地下室 + 地面层两件套 + 三件套地下室防水至关重要；工程范围扩大很快$30,000–$55,000

如何在大温哥华选择联排别墅浴室翻新承包商

三个标准可区分大温哥华优秀的联排别墅浴室翻新承包商与普通翻新商：

  • 物业小区经验：承包商必须此前提交过物业申请，了解每个小区附例的要求。要求提供同一城市两个联排别墅项目的参考资料。
  • 持牌且有保险：在BC省，超过$5,000的翻新工程需要持牌住宅建筑商。可在 licensingbc.ca 验证执照。
  • 现场项目经理：联排别墅翻新涉及与物业财产管理经理、有时是市府督察员以及多个工种的协调。专职现场项目经理可防止因沟通失误导致的成本超支。

大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新需要多长时间？

大温哥华单个联排别墅浴室翻新从许可证批准到交付通常需要3至6周。对于涉及单栋联排别墅3间或以上浴室的项目，准备6至10周。物业审批在任何许可证提交前增加2至6周。聚星裝修作为标准项目交付的一部分管理物业申请。

在不列颠哥伦比亚省，联排别墅浴室翻新需要物业批准吗？

在几乎所有情况下都需要。《物业产权法》要求物业委员会批准任何影响公共财产、相邻单元或建筑物外观的改造。即使是完全在您的单元内进行的翻新——新瓷砖、洗手柜、马桶——通常也需要物业通知表。您的承包商应将物业提交作为项目范围的一部分处理。

我可以一次只翻新联排别墅中的一间浴室吗？

可以。分期翻新在家庭需要继续居住在该房屋中的联排别墅中很常见。聚星裝修通常一次完成一间浴室，逐间进行。这会延长整体项目时间，但可将居住干扰保持在可管理范围内。与您的物业协调，确定工作时间以及材料搬运的电梯或楼梯通道。

2026年大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新的平均费用是多少？

2026年大温哥华联排别墅浴室翻新的平均费用在$22,000至$43,000之间（标准全面翻新）。配备定制瓷砖、地暖和高档五金的豪华主卧浴室费用在$43,000至$65,000+。基本翻新（新洗手柜、地板、墙面刷新和五金件）起价$14,000。所有数字均基于已完工项目合同，非估算。
